citation: Charles A. Church, Past and Present of the City of Rockford and Winnebago County, Illinois (1905), Milton Kilburn biographical notice
locator: Thomas J. Abbott biography, pp. 645-646, identifying Milton Kilburn as arriving from New Hampshire in 1835
note: Retrospective county-history lead for T-0482. It places an exact-name Milton Kilburn in northern Illinois in 1835 and later as Winnebago County's first probate judge, but it does not establish that the Chicago post-office letter-list entry is the same person.
